# FDG3057

> DO add the suffix “Dictionary.” Note that `IDictionary` is a specific type of collection, but this guideline takes precedence over the more general collections guideline that follows.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.2 Names of Common Types. Applies to: IDictionary IDictionary<TKey, TValue>.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1710
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

CA1710 does not report every dictionary type, such as a class derived from Dictionary<TKey, TValue>.
